title: Fable 5 fixing a real bug in my terminal
sub: Anthropic's most capable model — now in Claude Code
lines: Claude Code just got a new flagship model — here's Fable 5 fixing a bug in my terminal.
Clawd Code just got a new flagship model. Here is Fable five, fixing a bug in my terminal.
Claude Fable 5 — Anthropic says it is their most capable model yet.
Clawd Fable five. Anthropic says it is their most capable model yet.
One subtle off-by-one in a business-days counter — and a test that fails.
One subtle off by one, in a business days counter. And a test that fails.
claude --model claude-fable-5 — I just point it at the failing test.
I launch clawd, dash dash model clawd fable five, and point it at the failing test.
It traces the loop boundary — the inclusive end day was never counted.
It traces the loop boundary. The inclusive end day, was never being counted.
One-character fix, less-than to less-than-or-equal — all tests pass.
One character fix. Less than, becomes less than or equal. All tests pass.
Anthropic says the longer and more complex the task, the bigger its lead.
Anthropic says, the longer and more complex the task, the bigger Fable five's lead.
